_note: Editor-written from 灰帽特工's YouTube posts (read by hand at the owner's request, not by the robot). Steps are short, in our own words, with credit and a link. Never copy whole posts or images. Items disappear after 'until' (YYYY-MM-DD, Tokyo). Posts from the last 3 days also run as a story in their section.

creator.name: 灰帽特工 Gray Hat Agent

series.intro_zhHant: Red Horizon 賽季的獵捕偵查任務共 11 項，全部完成即可解鎖本季的獵捕終章任務。
series.intro_en: Red Horizon's 11 manhunt scouts. Finish them all to unlock the season's final manhunt mission.
series.untilNote: Season end not announced yet; update to the season's last day when Ubisoft announces it.

steps_zhHant: 在東下城區或司法廣場完成 2 次公開處決活動
佔領東下城區的 2 個控制點
在東下城區擊殺 10 名淨化者
steps_en: Complete 2 Public Execution activities in East Downtown or Judiciary Square
Take 2 control points in East Downtown
Kill 10 Cleaners in East Downtown

steps_zhHant: 在司法廣場擊殺 5 名淨化者
佔領「橢圓營區燃料庫」控制點
佔領東下城區任一敵方控制點
steps_en: Kill 5 Cleaners in Judiciary Square
Take the fuel-depot control point at the Ellipse camp (橢圓營區燃料庫)
Take any enemy control point in East Downtown

steps_zhHant: 在西波托馬克公園、西區或霧谷完成 2 次領地控制活動（地圖上紅色交叉霰彈槍圖示）
完成 3 次資源護送活動
擊殺任意 5 名具名敵人
steps_en: Complete 2 Territory Control activities (red crossed-shotguns map icon) in West Potomac Park, West End or Foggy Bottom
Complete 3 resource escort activities
Kill any 5 named enemies

steps_zhHant: 在東暗區或西暗區完成 2 個地標
在華盛頓完成 3 次淨化者陣營的開放世界活動
完成憲政大廳的指定懸賞
steps_en: Clear 2 landmarks in Dark Zone East or West
Complete 3 Cleaners open-world activities in Washington
Complete the listed bounty in Constitution Hall

steps_zhHant: 完成 2 次真實之子的宣傳廣播活動
擊殺 5 名黑牙無人機操作員
擊殺 25 名鬣狗
steps_en: Complete 2 True Sons Propaganda Broadcast activities
Kill 5 Black Tusk drone operators
Kill 25 Hyenas

steps_zhHant: 在開放世界完成解救人質活動（地圖上綠色手銬圖示）
擊殺 5 名具名或精英淨化者
以任意難度完成波托馬克活動中心任務
steps_en: Complete a Hostage Rescue activity in the open world (green handcuffs map icon)
Kill 5 named or elite Cleaners
Complete the Potomac Event Center mission on any difficulty

steps_zhHant: 佔領西南區的 2 個控制點
完成西南區的 3 項活動
在西南區完成 1 次資源護送活動
steps_en: Take 2 control points in the Southwest district
Complete 3 activities in the Southwest district
Complete 1 resource escort activity in the Southwest district

steps_zhHant: 完成 2 次流亡者陣營的宣傳廣播活動
完成「鬧鬼住宅」控制點
完成憲政大廳區域的指定懸賞
steps_en: Complete 2 Outcasts Propaganda Broadcast activities
Complete the “haunted house” control point (鬧鬼住宅)
Complete the listed bounty in the Constitution Hall area

steps_zhHant: 擊殺 3 名精英或具名鬣狗
擊殺 5 名醫療兵（他寫「暗牙醫療兵」）
完成 2 個鬣狗控制點
steps_en: Kill 3 elite or named Hyenas
Kill 5 medics (he writes “暗牙”, likely Black Tusk)
Complete 2 Hyena control points

steps_zhHant: 擊殺 50 名淨化者
完成 1 次淨化者陣營的領地控制活動
佔領 3 個淨化者陣營的控制點
steps_en: Kill 50 Cleaners
Complete 1 Cleaners Territory Control activity
Take 3 Cleaners control points

steps_zhHant: 完成三個黑牙陣營的白區（開放世界）活動
完成任一入侵副本
完成指定懸賞
steps_en: Complete three Black Tusk open-world activities
Complete any Incursion
Complete the listed bounty
entries.result_zhHant: 全部獵捕完成後，即可解鎖本季位於華盛頓機場的獵捕終章任務。
entries.result_en: With every manhunt done, this season's final manhunt mission at the Washington airport unlocks.

posts.text_zhHant: 為了部署跨平台基礎設施更新 遊戲將於11月10日下午4:30分進行停機維護。 預計停機時長:5小時
posts.text_en: 為了部署跨平台基礎設施更新 遊戲將於11月10日下午4:30分進行停機維護。 預計停機時長:5小時

posts.title_zhHant: 11 月第一輪 Twitch 掉寶開跑
posts.title_en: November's first Twitch Drops are live
posts.text_zhHant: 11 月 3 日至 10 日，在 Twitch 觀看《全境封鎖 2》合作直播達指定時數，即可領取限定獎勵。
posts.text_en: From 3 to 10 November, watch partnered The Division 2 streams on Twitch for long enough to earn limited rewards.

posts.title_zhHant: 11 月 3 日停機維護：中央公園 DLC 上線
posts.title_en: 3 Nov maintenance brings the Central Park DLC
posts.text_zhHant: 灰帽特工提醒：11 月 3 日下午 4:00（他貼文的時間）停機約 6 小時，維護後推出全新中央公園 DLC。更新日誌見 Ubisoft 官方連結。
posts.text_en: 灰帽特工 flagged a roughly 6-hour maintenance on 3 November from 4:00 pm (his time zone) to launch the new Central Park DLC. Patch notes are on Ubisoft's site.

posts.title_zhHant: 兌換碼合集：臂章、帽子西裝、背包
posts.title_en: Redeem codes: armbands, hats & suits, backpack
posts.text_zhHant: 到 Ubisoft 兌換網站輸入即可領取外觀。10 月的創作者臂章與帽子西裝碼較新；8–9 月的 gamescom 臂章和中央公園彩蛋背包碼可能已過期。背包到手後記得掃一下上面的 QR 碼。
posts.text_en: Enter these on Ubisoft's redeem site for free cosmetics. October's creator armbands and hats-and-suits code are the newest; the August–September gamescom armband and Central Park backpack codes may have expired. Scan the QR code on the backpack once you have it.

posts.title_zhHant: 倖存者 DLC：冬季華盛頓生存模式
posts.title_en: Survivors DLC: a winter survival mode for Washington
posts.text_zhHant: 依官方釋出的概念圖與說明，倖存者 DLC 會把華盛頓變成冬天，玩法類似一代的生存模式，分 PvP 與 PvE 兩種，並有「更厚的雪層」等新機制。封閉測試曾開放報名（9 月底），現在是否仍開放請以官方頁面為準。
posts.text_en: Going by the official concept art and notes, the Survivors DLC turns Washington into winter with a survival mode like the first game's, in separate PvP and PvE versions, plus new touches such as deeper snow. A closed-test sign-up opened in late September; check Ubisoft's page to see if it is still open.

posts.title_zhHant: 全防逆火第二套：只有 12 精防也能用
posts.title_en: All-armor Backfire, take two: for 12 armor cores
posts.text_zhHant: 很多特工沒有 13 個精防，灰帽特工因此給出第二套全防逆火配裝：12 精防也不掉強度，還多 10% 擊殺回甲。爆頭率低於約 70% 的話，把爆頭傷害換成暴擊傷害 DPS 會更高。
posts.text_en: Many agents don't have 13 armor cores, so 灰帽特工 posted a second all-armor Backfire setup that works with 12 and adds 10% armor on kill. If your headshot rate is below about 70%, swap headshot damage for crit damage for more DPS.
